licence: MSRS: Multi-Spectral Road Scenarios for Practical Infrared and Visible Image Fusion (Tang et al.). Obtained from the authors' own repository github.com/Linfeng-Tang/MSRS, which commits the dataset as tracked files. Research use; cite the original paper. The images are NOT redistributed by this project -- only the download script and the provenance record are committed.

attempts.note: Official MSRS repository, dataset committed as tracked files. Sparse checkout of the image directories plus the detection labels.

split_definition: The dataset's own published partition, reproduced verbatim: train/ is used for fitting and test/ is the held-out split (reported as 'val'). No re-splitting is performed, so these numbers are comparable to published MSRS results.
split_note: MSRS ships train/ and test/; test/ is named 'val' throughout this codebase because no MSRS method trains on it.
notes: Primary benchmark dataset. 1444 pairs across the published train/test partition, plus 80 detection pairs for YOLOv5x6 mAP.
